note: User stories deferred from main file - not blocking MVP

deferredStories.title: Streamline EscapePlan admin console workflows
deferredStories.story: As a general manager, I want a polished admin console so I can manage users, games, and network settings quickly during live operations.
acceptanceCriteria: All admin forms provide inline validation and success/error feedback.
Role/permission visibility is clear for each navigation link.
PWA prompts and update banners behave consistently across browsers.
deferredStories.businessValue: Reduces training time and minimizes operational mistakes during busy sessions.
deferredStories.technicalNotes: Build on Better-Auth/Refine foundation once finalized; reuse DaisyUI theme tokens.
risks: Design churn if Better-Auth components differ from current layout.
testCases: Run usability walkthrough covering user creation, game edits, network updates.
Verify offline queue + PWA reload prompt flow after service worker update.

deferredStories.title: Review analytics and daily run sheets
deferredStories.story: As the owner, I want visibility into performance so I can plan staffing and marketing.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows throughput, hint usage, and revenue summaries derived from deposits/balances.
Exports available as CSV/PDF without internet access.
Reports differentiate store vs mobile bookings.
deferredStories.businessValue: Supports data-driven decisions and future growth.
testCases: Generate daily report and confirm metrics accuracy against sample data.

deferredStories.title: Operate offline with reliable sync
deferredStories.story: As the mobile coordinator, I need offline access and sync so events run even without internet.
acceptanceCriteria: Critical data (bookings, puzzles, hints) cached on devices prior to events.
Offline hint/session actions queue locally and sync when back online.
Operators see sync status and conflict prompts with manual resolution steps.
deferredStories.businessValue: Enables revenue from remote events without connectivity costs.
testCases: Simulate offline session and confirm data syncs correctly after reconnection.

deferredStories.title: Capture mobile booking logistics notes
deferredStories.story: As the owner, I need to record logistics for mobile bookings so crews know where to go.
acceptanceCriteria: Bookings support free-form location notes, arrival window, and contact details.
System warns when mobile bookings overlap for the same game or crew but does not auto-route travel.
Printable run sheet includes mobile-specific notes.
deferredStories.businessValue: Protects customer experience and reduces overtime.
deferredStories.technicalNotes: Travel time calculations deferred; manual buffers only.
testCases: Schedule overlapping mobile events and ensure conflict detection triggers.

deferredStories.title: Label mobile-ready games and assets
deferredStories.story: As the owner, I want to flag which games are mobile-ready so I can schedule them for offsite events.
acceptanceCriteria: Games include an `is_mobile` flag visible in admin UI and APIs.
Bookings list mobile games separately with location notes and required transport instructions.
Reports can filter by mobile vs storefront bookings.
deferredStories.businessValue: Keeps catalog organized for mobile deployments without full kit inventory.
testCases: Mark kit item missing and verify warning on upcoming event.
